macros.name: DeclareCaseLangs
macros.doc: Defines the list of languages which are considered by the \MakeSentenceCase* command as it converts a string to sentence case.

macros.name: ifcaselang
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the optional ⟨language⟩ is one of those declared by \DeclareCaseLangs (see § 4.6.4) and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: MakeCapital
macros.doc: Similar to \MakeUppercase but only converts the first printable character in ⟨text⟩ to uppercase.

macros.name: MakeSentenceCase
macros.doc: Converts its ⟨text⟩ argument to sentence case, i. e., the first word is capitalized and the remainder of the string is converted to lowercase.

macros.name: UndeclareBabelToExplLanguageMapping
macros.doc: Removes the babel-to-expl3 language mapping for hbabel languagei.
